taxon_descr: Phytoplankton (spp.)
Benthic primary producer (spp.)
Micro and Mesozooplankton (spp.)
Macrozooplankton (euphasids, pteropods and fish larvae and eggs)
Gelatinous plankton (cubozoa, hydrozoa, scyphozoa, tunicata)
Polychaetes (nematods and annelids)
Suprabenthos (mysids, isopods, amphipods, cumaceans and copepods)
Native shrimps (Aristeus antennatus, Aristaemorpha foliacea, Parapennaeus longirostris, Plesionika martia and Squilla mantis)
Alien shrimps (Marsupennaeus japonicus, Metapenaeopsis aegyptia, Metapenaeus monoceros, Penaeus semisulcatus and Trachysalambria curvirostris)
Native crabs (Alpheus spp., Callinectes sapidus, Calappa granulata, Dardanus arrosor, Inachus dorsettensis, Latreilla elegans, Medorippe lanata and Scyllarides lateus)
Alien crabs (Charybdis longicollis, Erugosquilla massavensis, Ixa monody, Myra subgranulata and Portunus pelagicus)
Benthic invertebrates (echinoderms, bivalves, gastropods, cnidarians and sponges)
Benthic cephalopods (Octopus vulgaris, Sepia elegans, Sepia officinalis, Sepia orbignyana and Sepietta oweniana)
Benthopelagic cephalopods (Illex coindetii and Loligo vulgaris)
Mullets (Mullus barbatus and Mullus surmuletus)
Goatfishes (Upeneus moluccensis and Upeneus pori)
Hake (Merluccius merluccius)
Flatfishes (Arnoglossus spp., Bothus podas, Buglossidium luteum, Citharus linguatula, Cynoglossus sinusarabici, Microchirus spp., Solea solea and Symphurus nigrescens)
Rocky fishes (Apogon imberbis, Chromis chromis, Blennius ocellaris, Diplodus annularis, D. cervinus, D. puntazzo, D. sargus, D. vulgaris and Gobius spp.)

Small native demersal fishes (Ariosoma balearicum, Balistes capriscus, Callionymus risso, Cepola macrophthalma, Chelidonichthys cuculus, Chelidonichthys lucerna, Dactylopterus volitans, Deltentosteus quadrimaculatus, Echelus myrus, Echeneis naucrates, Eutrigla gurnardus, Lepidotrigla cavillone, L. dieuzeidei, Lithognathus mormyrus, Liza aurata, L. ramada, Mugil cephalus, Oblada melanura, Pagellus acarne, P. bogaraveo, P. erythrinus, Pagrus caeruleostictus, P. pagrus, Phycis blennoides, P. physis, Pomadasys incisus, Sciaena umbra, Scorpaena notata, S. porcus, S. scrofa, Serranus cabrilla, S. hepatus,  Sparus aurata, Synodus saurus, Trachinus araneus, Trigla lyra, Trigloporus lastoviza, Uranoscopus scaber and Zeus faber)
Large native demersal fishes (Argyrosomus regius, Epinephelus aeneus, E. costae, E. marginatus, Hyporthodus haifensis, Dentex dentex, D. gibbosus, D. macropthalmus and D. maroccanus)
Alien herbivores (Siganus luridus and S. rivulatus)

Earlier alien demersal fishes (Apogonichthyoides pharaonis, Callionymus filamentosus, Equulites klunzingeri, Lagocephalus spadiceus, L. suezensis, Pelates quadrilineatus, Pempheris rhomboidea, Pomadasys stridens, Sargocentron rubrum, Sillago sihama, Stephanolepis diaspros and Torquigener flavimaculosus)
New alien demersal fishes (Cheilodipterus novemstriatus, Jaydia queketti, J. smithi, Lagocephalus sceleratus, Nemipterus randalli, Ostorhinchus fasciatus, Plotosus lineatus and Trypauchen vagina)
Alien lizardfish (Saurida lessepsianus)
Demersal fishes (upper slope) (Coelorhynchus caelorhinchus, Conger conger, Echiodon dentatus, Helicolenus dactylopterus, Lepidopus caudatus, Lophius budegassa and Nettastoma melanurum)
Benthopelagic fishes (Boops boops, Capros aper, Macrorhamphosus scolopax, Spicara maena and S. smaris)
Mesopelagic fishes (Chlorophthalmus agassizi, Hygophum hygomii, Lampanyctus crocodilus, L. pusillus, Myctophium punctatum, Stomias boa and Vinciguerria poweridae)
Demersal sharks (Carchinus obscurus, C. plumbeus and Mustelus mustelus)
Rays and skates (Dasyatis chrysonota, D. pastinaca, Raja miraletus, Rhinobatos rhinobatos, R. cemiculus, Torpedo marmorata and T. torpedo)
Small pelagic fishes (Engraulis encrasicolus, Etrumeus golanii, Sardina pilchardus and Sardinella aurita)
Horse mackerel (Trachurus mediterraneus, T. picturatus and T. trachurus)
Mackerel (Scomber colias)
Native medium pelagic fishes (Alepes djedaba Caranx crysos, Sphyraena chrysotaenia and S. shyraena)
Alien medium pelagic fishes (Decapterus russelli and Fistularia commersonii)
Large pelagic fishes (Euthynnus alletteratus, Seriola dumerili, Scomberomorus commerson, Xiphias gladius and Thunnus thynnus)
Turtles (Caretta caretta and Chelonia mydas)
Sea birds (Calonectris diomedea, Morus bassanus, Oceanodroma leucoroha, Puffinus griseus, Puffinus yelkouan and Stercorarius parasiticus)
Dolphins (Delphinus delphis, Grampus griseus, Stenella coeruleoalba, Steno bredanensis, Tursiops truncatus and Ziphius cavirostris)
Detritus
Discards
